policy: New publication uses Snapshot v5 Starter openings. Historical v4 releases retain their original bytes, hash and republish semantics. API v1 and Bridge v3 remain unchanged; incompatible schema meanings require a new version and explicit preservation plan. Remote workspace runtime descriptors require Relay protocol v2; remote workspace usage targets use targetVersion 2. Snapshot v5 and legacy admission/fact byte semantics remain unchanged. Unpublished v5 has one current schema: Starter has no description; background blocks contain only id/content, no title. Retained v4 remains independent.
